name: 922 Setup
description: Runs the full 922 batch-prep sequence behind a master toggle window: Generate Teams Cards (pipeline buckets + one pallet-labelled Teams card per order via a Power Automate webhook), Batch Repeater (pull repeats, distribute CAD/binders, label REPEAT cards), and Pallet Stamper - each stage toggleable, batch number shared across stages.
author: Anthony Sieben

fields.label: 922 Production Packages Root
fields.description: Where 'Batch {N}' folders live. Leave blank to auto-detect '922 QTDR Production Packages' under your OneDrive Pilot Program folder.
fields.placeholder: Auto-detect: OneDrive \ ... \ Pilot Program \ 922 QTDR Production Packages

fields.label: Teams Webhook URL (override)
fields.description: Leave blank to use TechDeck's built-in card-creation flow. Only set this to point at a different Power Automate flow (get the URL from that flow's trigger). Use the Dry run toggle below to preview without posting.

fields.label: Dry run (preview only)
fields.description: When on, build and log the cards and save a preview JSON, but do not post to the webhook. Forced on automatically when no webhook URL is set.
